# Pastel Dusk

Pastel Dusk is a dark-only palette with a deep near-neutral background and soft turquoise accents on buttons, tags and active states. Headings take distinct muted pastels, links and filenames are rendered in soft blues, and panes are presented as floating cards with rounded corners.

![Pastel Dusk screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/surprisedduck/obsidian-pastel-dusk/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue

    name:   "Pastel Dusk"
    author: "SurprisedDuck"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]

}
```
